chapters: Ba' jix aa' jup tɨɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bɨɨx dɨr vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios gu vaakax tu' gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' tu' gu maa'nkar ua'tulhi'ñ maa'nkar tai bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ cham; gio ba' aagak ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ bhaan mo'o maa'nkar tai bhaan; gio ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tuur gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu ɨ'ɨr xikoolh bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu tai bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'u bhaan gu tai.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mo'o gu tanoolh na jix bhai' bhaan gu u'u bhaan gu tai tu jiim jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu suudai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bɨx bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; mi' dhɨr maa'nkar tai bhaan gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' gu maa'nkar na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan ua'tulhi'ñ kakneer kaneer gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.

Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x jodai maa'nkar Jawatan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan xikoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx mo'o gu tanoolh na jix bhai'; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bhaan gu u'u bhaan gu tai tu jiim jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' ba'k gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu suudai'; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx jix maat bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; mi' dhɨr maa'nkar tai bhaan gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' maa'nkar tai bhaan bhɨɨya' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu u'uvhig gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan tu' jix duñia' mo'o jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' gu ɨ'ɨr ka't bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' ju'ñdharan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bhaan tas buusñi pai'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu' cham gook; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bhaan gu u'u gu tai; mi' dhɨr maa'nkar tai bhaan gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar ka't bhaan bɨ'ñdhatu' bhaan kubhion.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook jix bhuup bɨ'ñdhatu' bɨɨx bɨx kubhion bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook ka't gu takarui' cham jabka' bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' jajar cham jabka' bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Gu' gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ua'tulhi'ñ gu maa'nkar ka't cham jabka' bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan bɨ'ñdhatu'; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ua'tulhi'ñ gu maa'nkar jix maat bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar dhi' tu'x jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan mii' dhɨr chɨ'ñchoka' jix maat bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx jabka'; na gu' matgɨm jix duñia' tu' matgɨm gu ñi'ook tu' gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu maa'nkar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gu' cham jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu maa'nkar bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham jix duu jix duñia' mɨɨjidha' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ux na tu ibai' gu tai kaipgaidhat gu ñi'ook kai'ñ jix duñia' gu maa'nkar gu ux na tu ibai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan bɨ'ñdhatu' bhaan kubhion; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨ'ñchoka' baasɨ'n kai'ñ jix duñia' bɨ'ñdhatu' bɨɨx bɨx kubhion; gio ba' gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' gu maa'nkar ua'tulhi'ñ gu maa'nkar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhɨɨya' jix duñia' gu vaakax ka't gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ cham vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ bhaan mo'o gu maa'nkar ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' bɨx bhaan ba'k.
Jano' ba' gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan bɨɨx gu tanoolh na jix bhai' bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bhaan maa'nkar tai bhaan bhaan gu u'u tu jiim gu tai; gio ba' gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' tu' kakneer ua'tulhi'ñ gu maa'nkar na ba' gu maa'nkar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ cham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mar kaneer gu maa'nkar tu' jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ bhaan mo'o gu maa'nkar mi' dhɨr vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu maa'nkar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios tatk jix duñia' bɨx bhaan ba'k.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook bhaan bɨɨx gu tanoolh na jix bhai' bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' ua'tulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ bhaan mo'o vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨx bhaan ba'k.
Jano' ba' gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan bɨɨx gu tanoolh na jix bhai' bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ñi'ook kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨx tu' matgɨm gu ɨ'ɨr jugi.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook oi'ñdha' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan tu'x cham jix duñia' bhaan oi'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' tu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan uañi'ñ gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios uañi'ñ tuur cham na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tuur ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ bhaan mo'o tuur vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ gu ɨ'ɨr tuur gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ɨ'ɨr mii' dhɨr gu ɨ'ɨr kɨɨv mui'kim vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bhaan jix duñia' xidhuu.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan a'aa' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bɨx gu ɨ'ɨr tuur tɨɨt jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tuur na ba' bɨx jix duñia' bɨx bhaan ba'k.
Jano' ba' gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan bɨɨx gu tanoolh na jix bhai' bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax gu maa'nkar; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tuur bɨx gu chuukug bɨɨx mo'o gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx tuur gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mai' yooxi' pai' na jix bhai' pai' gu ñi'ook gu tai bhaan gu u'u; gio ba' pai' ka't.
Jano' ba' tu' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel bhɨɨya' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook bhaan oi'ñdha' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu'x cham jix duñia' duñia' ua'tulhi'ñ jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' ua'tulhi'ñ gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n uañi'ñ bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tuur vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' daraa gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu noobh bhaan mo'o tuur vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr tuur.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ɨ'ɨr tuur vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ɨ'ɨr kɨɨv mui'kim vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bhaan jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ɨ'ɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan a'aa' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ɨ'ɨr tɨɨt jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx jix maat bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr tuur na ja'p bɨɨx tuur gu ñi'ook; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tuur mai' vaak ja'tkam gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu ñi'ook maa'n tuur; gio ba'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bhaan oi'ñdha' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan tu'x cham jix duñia' duñia'.
Jano' ba' ua'tulhi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ tu' gu maa'nkar gu chio'ñ chiiw cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ bhaan mo'o gu chio'ñ chiiw pai' maa'nkar tai bhaan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba'.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan a'aa' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr tɨɨt jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ja'p gu maa'nkar; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook kua'dam gu ja'tkam duñia' gu ñi'ook bhaan oi'ñdha' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu'x cham jix duñia' duñia'.
Jano' ba' ua'tulhi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ gu maa'nkar gu u'vɨ gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n cham uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ bhaan mo'o pai' maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan a'aa' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ɨ'ɨr tɨɨt jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx ka't gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu maa'nkar; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook ka't.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' mar kaneer na ba' gu maa'nkar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ gu u'vɨ cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ bhaan mo'o pai' maa'nkar tai bhaan.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan a'aa' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ɨ'ɨr tɨɨt jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx na ja'p ka't gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu maa'nkar jix maat jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bhaan gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ ka't.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhɨɨya' naak gu ñi'ook ua'tulhi'ñ ñi'ookdham jix ñi' tu' cham uañi'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhɨɨya' dhaa no'x gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a ka't gu chuukug jix koi gu vaakax gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu chuukug jix koi gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n ñaanbi' gu chuukug jix koi gu ko'oi ñaanbi' xoi'kam cham ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Jano' ba' tu' kuichdha' gu chio'ñ ñaanbi' no'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñaanbi' cham; gio ba' tu' mi' dhɨr maachim ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gio gu ñi'ook duñiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix duñia' cham bhai' gu ñi'ook tu'x gu chio'ñ bɨɨx gu ñi'ook cham; gio ba' tu' mi' dhɨr ka't gu ñi'ook dhi' tu'x.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' tu'x mii' dhɨr jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios uañi'ñ tu' gu u'vɨ kakneer ali' karneer gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n na ja'p gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' mar kaneer gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ gook gu ñi'ook gook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' maa'n na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n na ba' mo'o baakux gu' cham bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' gu ɨ'ɨr tɨɨt jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan jurtu'nka'; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ ka't.
Gu' gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham na ba' gook gu ñi'ook gook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu Epa; na gu' cham bhaan bɨ'ñdhatu' tu' bhaan kubhion na gu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook jix bhuup chɨ'ñchoka' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ dhi' tu'x ka't; gio ba' ka't jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan na ja'p.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ tu'x gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook cham kakneer jurtu'nka' jix toja jodai xidhuu gu maa'nkar uañi'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr tu'x jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' bhɨɨya' uañi'ñ gu ñi'ook jixchamaam maa'n jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar uañi'ñ ka't.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bɨx mii' dhɨr tu'x gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham jix duñia' duñia' cham duñia' jix duñia' uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook cham kakneer; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tɨtmo tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu novɨ xoi'kam tɨtmo.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duñiim ɨɨxi'ñdha' mii' dhɨr tu'x gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨx mii' dhɨr bhaan bhɨɨya' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' baasɨ'n tu' jix duñia' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook cham jurtu'nka' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan na ba'.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios no'x tu'x.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam bham; gio ba' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga maa'nkar tai bhaan; na gu' maa'nkar tai bhaan na gu' bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bɨx gu tukaa' bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh gu tai jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu chuukug; na pai' dhuuk gu tai bhɨɨya' maa'nkar tai bhaan bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ju'ñdharan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mai' vaak ja'tkam pai' na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tai jix duñia' bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan cham tu' dɨbaalhga'n gu ñi'ook jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'u gu xibh bhaan maa'nkar tai bhaan bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tai tu' xib ja'k tɨkɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' cham.
Jano' ba' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨ'ñdhatu' bɨx kubhion bhaan jix maat bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan chɨ'ñchoka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam; gio ba' cham jabka' gu ñi'ook pai' jix bhaan; mi' dhɨr vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jugi.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx jabka'; gio ba' jix maa maa'nkar na jix maa; mi' dhɨr na ja'p uañi'ñ na ja'p gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu chio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jugi; gio ba' ñi'ook kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't na ba' gu ma'nkam maa'nkar na jix maa gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr bɨx kuichdha' ka't.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu maa'nkar gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh ka't; gio ba' gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu Epa tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu xibh tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu xumai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu'; gio ba' bapaalh gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan pai' gu Aaroon ua'tulhi'ñ Xoi'kam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar; gio ba' ñi'ook kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr bɨx ka't vaak na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ka't jix duñia'; gio ba' cham jugi.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam bham; gio ba' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr pai' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan ka't gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jugi; gio ba' pai' jix bhaan ka't jugi vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu chuukug kuichdha' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan tɨi'chu' mii' dhɨr bhaan pai' jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bhi'ñ ua'tulhi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't; gio ba' tu' ua'tulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam ka't bɨɨx gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu chio'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jugi; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Gu' gu' cham jugi gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ɨ'ɨr vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut na ba' xidhuu; gio ba' gu tai ka't vaak na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt abhaar.
Jano' ba' pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan; gio ba' bɨɨx gu tanoolh na jix bhai' bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu chio'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jugi; gio ba' ka't jugi pai' jix bhaan; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt abhaar.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ñi'ook na tu a'ga jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr ka't jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan oi'ñdha' gu ñi'ook maa'nkar tai bhaan ka't na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook bɨx ua'tulhi'ñ ka't jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' jix gaki ka't bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon maa'n na ja'p.
Jano' ba' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu maa'nkar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam taxchaabgidhat taxchaabgi'ñ gu maa'nkar taxchaabgidhat taxchaabgi'ñ gu takarui' cham jabka' bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' jajar cham jabka' bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' gu takarui' bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu takarui' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar taxchaabgi'ñ.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu maa'nkar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baasɨ'n gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ɨ'ɨr.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu maa'nkar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam taxchaabgidhat taxchaabgi'ñ jugi gu tanoolh ua'tulhi'ñ; gio ba' cham cham tu' na ba' gu tanoolh.
Gu' gu' tu' gu maa'nkar ua'tulhi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh gu maa'nkar ka't; gio ba' jugi tu' gu tanoolh buimgidhak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' vaik gu tanoolh gu chuukug gu maa'nkar ka't gu tai.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chuukug gu maa'nkar vaik gu tanoolh cham ka't tu' ka't; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug kuichdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a cham jugi; gio ba' gu tai ka't vaak na jix bhaan; gu' no'x jugi gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chuukug gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios kua' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook kuichdha' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu chio'ñ gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n ñaanbi' no'x gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu chuukug gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax tu' mar kaneer tu' gu ñi'ook jugi.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n ka't jix duñia' na ba' no'x gu' cham jugi.
Na gu' na gu' no'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam matgɨm gu ɨ'ɨr jugi bɨx gu u'uvhig na ja'p gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' no'x gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ɨ'ɨr jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu noobh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak na jix bhai' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bɨɨx baaso; mi' dhɨr baaso na ba' ka't na ja'p gu maa'nkar vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gu' baaso ka't gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan na ba' gu maa'nkar tu jiim makgɨrxi'ñdha'.
Na gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ɨ'ɨr ka't tu jiim.
Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baaso gu maa'nkar jix maa gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam ñi'ook kavɨk gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam baasɨ'n gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios dɨr gu tanoolh na ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr gu tanoolh tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel ñi'ook kavɨk gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga maa'nkar tai bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu kavɨk gu Sinaii gu tanoolh jix aa'ñdhix gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios oidha' jix gaki gu Sinaii.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨ'ñdhatu' tuur gook gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix jum daa'ñ gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu ñi'ook; gio ba' dhi' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jix duñia' bɨɨx gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas bhaan gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' mi' dhɨr jix dhaas bhaan bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix dhaas gu Urim gu Tummim.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan mo'o; gio ba' bhaan jix bhai'x jix dhaas jix uam jodai abhaar; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Moisees bɨ'ñdhatu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu jiim vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan bɨx tu'x mi'p jix bhaan duu.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan kɨɨv mui'kim tu jiim jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bɨx suudai' buusñi na ba' jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' ja'aa bɨ'ñdhatu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan mo'o gu Aaroon tu jiim na ba' jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix duu mi' dhɨr gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tuur gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jix dhaas gu noobh bhaan mo'o tuur.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Moisees jix bhɨɨ gu ɨ'ɨr jix dhaas bɨɨx bhaan a'aa' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan xikoolh jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu ɨ'ɨr tɨɨt jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix bhaan duu na ba' bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix duu mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't bhaan gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gook tu' gu Moisees bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Gu' gu' tuur gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu tai mai' vaak ja'tkam; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix duu mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jix dhaas gu noobh bhaan mo'o gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Moisees gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Moisees jix duu mo'o gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu suudai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Moisees bɨx gu ñi'ook bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr na ja'p ka't gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix duu mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jix dhaas gu noobh bhaan mo'o gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Moisees gu ɨ'ɨr jix dhaas bhaan naak tu jiim gu Aaroon bhaan gu novɨ tu jiim bhaan tɨɨt gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix dhaas gu Moisees gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan gu ñi'ook bhaan gu noobh gu ñi'ook bhaan tɨɨt gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Moisees gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx ka't bhaan gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gook tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix bhɨɨ gu takarui' cham jabka' gu takarui' bɨ'ñdhatu' jix dhaas bɨɨx tu jiim.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix dhaas bɨx gu noobh gu Aaroon gu noobh gu ma'nkam tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu maa'nkar vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duu mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ mii' dhɨr tu'x gu Moisees gu noobh tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bhaan maa'nkar tai bhaan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Moisees baaso gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't baasɨ'n gu Moisees; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Moisees.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Moisees bɨ'ñdhatu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ɨ'ɨr ka't bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bhaan gu Aaroon bhaan kutun bhaan gu ma'nkam bhaan kutun gu ma'nkam bɨɨx; gio ba' jix bhaan duu gu Aaroon kutun gu ma'nkam kutun gu ma'nkam bɨɨx.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chuukug ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx gu takarui' bhaan tu' jix duñia' bham; jano' ba' gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jugi.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chuukug gu takarui' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tai.
Jano' ba' ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv gu tanoolh bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh; na gu' kɨɨv gu tanoolh boopoya'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook jix aa'ñdhix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut dhi' gu tanoolh gu tukaa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv gu tanoolh jir bɨx bhai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' cham vaak jodai; na gu' tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jix duu bɨx tu'x jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tanoolh jix bhai'x gu Moisees jup tɨɨt gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam daraa gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Aaroon; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tuur na ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan cham vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ chiiw na ba' tuur mar kaneer oi'ñga' cham na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax gu ñi'ook na ba' gu maa'nkar vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bhaan.
Jano' ba' bhɨɨk jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees; gio ba' dhi' jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Aaroon; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu vupui gu ñi'ook maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vupui tu' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu vupui gio gu maa'nkar gu ja'tkam gu vupui; jano' ba' na ja'p tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aaroon jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' tuur ka't.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon aichdhak gu ɨ'ɨr; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ɨ'ɨr jix dhaas bhaan a'aa' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ja'aa gu ɨ'ɨr tɨɨt jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh na jix bhai' bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Moisees.
Gu' gu' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu tai mai' vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu ɨ'ɨr xikoolh bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mi' dhɨr maa'nkar tai bhaan gu ñi'ook mo'o; gio ba' tu' jix duu bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhaan maa'nkar tai bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' makgɨrxi gio gu maa'nkar gu ja'tkam jix bhɨɨ gu chio'ñ chiiw ka't na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam makgɨrxi uañi'ñ na ja'p maa'n.
Jano' ba' jix duu makgɨrxi maa'nkar tai bhaan tu' bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' jix duu makgɨrxi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu novɨ bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan gu xibh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio gu vaakax gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar ka't gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan xikoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx jix duñia' ba'k gu tanoolh na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx tu jiim gu Aaroon gu maa'nkar vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Moisees.
Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aaroon gu noobh bhaan gu ja'tkam jix bhai' aa'; gio ba' jix dhaav bhaan maa'nkar tai bhaan gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' baap gu Moisees gu Aaroon vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' moor jix bhai' aa' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios jix ñi'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu tai vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam ia'rɨ bhaan gu vupui.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu Nadab gu Abiuu jix bhɨɨ maa'n vaak na jix bhaan jix dhaas gu tai bhaan jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu tai gu tanoolh na jix bhai' cham pai' dhuuk jix aa'ñdhix.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu tai vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix koko' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees gu Aaroon; gio ba' dhi' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam jix duñia' tas na jix gɨ'; jano' ba' gu Aaroon.
Ba' jix aa' jup tɨɨt gu Moisees gu Misael gu Elsapaan gu ma'nkam gu Ussiel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aaroon; gio ba' jix buusñi gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan xidhuu mai' yooxi'.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook mai' yooxi' na ja'p gu Moisees.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu Eleasar gu Itamar gu ma'nkam; na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨɨbhidham tu' jajannulhi'ñ na gu' cham vaak jodai tu' jix duñia' daak bhaan bɨx gu ñi'ook; gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bɨx gu vaak gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut na gu' koi; na gu' bɨ'ñdhatu' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix duu jurtu'nka' tu ñi'ook gu Moisees.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Aaroon bham.
Na pai' dhuuk tu' gu ma'nkam bɨndak cham i'i suudai' u'va tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk baakɨi vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut na gu' cham vaak jodai; gio ba' ñi'ook kavɨk gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhaan tɨjɨɨ'ñ ñaanbi' na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨx ñi'ook kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Moisees.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu Eleasar gu Itamar gu ma'nkam a'ga jix duñia'; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios cham jabka' ju'ñdharan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na gu' gu bhóogɨt abhaar.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jugi pai' jix bhaan; na gu' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' tu' na ba' gu ma'nkam gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia'.
Na gu' jugi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' na jix bhai' tu' gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ bɨndak baaso na gu' na ba' tu' na ba' gu ma'nkam makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu vaak na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' jix duu tu' baaso ka't na ba' gu maa'nkar vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ka't gu ma'nkam bɨndak na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ chiiw gu ñi'ook ka't; gio ba' bhaam bhaan gu Eleasar tu' gu Itamar gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix duñia' bham.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook pai' jix bhaan na gu' gu bhóogɨt abhaar jix maa gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' ka't vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ɨ'ɨr cham ka't gu ñi'ook xidhuu; gio ba' dua'ñ jugi pai' jix bhaan na ja'p tu'.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Aaroon gu Moisees; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' maa'nkar tai bhaan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gu' jix duñia' dhi' tu'x; na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Moisees jix kai dhi' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu vaakax jugi bɨx gu vaakax bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaakax bɨx gu ñi'ook juraa'n gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam cham gu ñi'ook cham jugi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam namki' gu ñi'ook; na gu' jix ai na gu' gu' cham juraa'n gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jix xoi'kam ñaanbi'.
Na gu' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' gu' cham juraa'n gu ñi'ook gui'x ñaanbi'.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' gu' cham juraa'n gu ñi'ook gui'x gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Na gu' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' juraa'n gu ñi'ook gu' cham gui'x ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug cham jugi tu' kuichdha' gu chuukug jix koi; gio ba' gui'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' dhi' jugi bɨx tu'x gu suudai'; gio ba' bɨx tu'x namki' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai' gu gɨ' suudai' mii' dhɨr jugi.
Gu' gu' bɨx tu'x cham namki' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu gɨ' suudai' bɨx gu ko'oi gu suudai' na ja'p bɨx na jix do'ig gu suudai' gui'x.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu chuukug cham jugi gu chuukug koko'kam.
Jano' ba' bɨx cham palhɨɨp gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai' gui'x.
Jano' ba' gu u'uvhig gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gui'x; gio ba' cham jugi ka't; mi' dhɨr gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan na jax chu'm.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook bhaan na jax chu'm.
Jano' ba' gu u'uuv gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a bhaan na jax chu'm.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan na jax chu'm vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ko'oi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan maakobh tɨɨt gui'x.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook dhi' jugi bɨx gu ko'oi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jiim bhaan maakobh tɨɨt palhɨɨp gu ñi'ook tɨɨt na ba' gu ta'm na tu maakia' gu Dios bɨɨx bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jugi; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan na jax chu'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan na jax chu'm bhaan na jax chu'm bhaan na jax chu'm.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ko'oi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' maakobh tɨɨt gui'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' tu'x boopoya' jix duñia'; gio ba' no'x kuichdha' gu chuukug koko'kam ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' no'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chuukug koko'kam jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu' cham juraa'n gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gui'x ñaanbi'; gio ba' no'x kuichdha' ka't ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu vaakax gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maakobh tɨɨt gui'x ñaanbi' no'x bhaan; gio ba' no'x kuichdha' gu chuukug koko'kam ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chuukug koko'kam jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai; gio ba' jix duñia' jix xoi'kam jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gui'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu ko'oi gu ko' na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim bhaan gu oidha'; gio ba' bhaan na jax chu'm.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gui'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x bɨx gu ko'oi; na pai' dhuuk no'x kuichdha' na pai' dhuuk koko'kam ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.

Jano' ba' bɨx mii' dhɨr bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñdha' mi' dhɨr koko'kam ka't ñaanbi'; gio ba' vaaso gu u'u na ja'p tɨi'chu' zel bɨɨx duñia' gu ñi'ook ka't gu suudai' ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai ka't.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook bhi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñdha' bɨx ka't ñaanbi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi bhaan daraibu' gu suudai' ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; gio ba' bɨx ka't bɨx jix duñia' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Jano' ba' bɨx mii' dhɨr bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu chuukug jix koi ka't ñaanbi'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gui'x.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx suudai' buusñi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' gu suudai' ka't gu ñi'ook; gu' bhɨɨya' dhaa gu chuukug koko'kam ka't ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chuukug koko'kam bhaan gu kai' ka't gu ñi'ook ka't na jix bhai'.
Gu' gu' tu' bhɨɨya' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu kai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chuukug koko'kam bhaan gui'x gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n na ba' jugi vaak jodai kuichdha' gu chuukug jix koi ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chuukug jix koi jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai; gio ba' jix buusñi gu chuukug jix koi jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ko'oi tu' gu ko' na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim bhaan gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham jugi.
Na gu' bɨx jiim bhaan baaso bɨx jiim bhaan maakobh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨt bɨx gu ko'oi jiim gu ko' na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim bhaan gu oidha' cham jugi na gu'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ko'oi gu ko' na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim tu' bɨɨx tu' jix duñia'.
Na gu' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam boopoya' jɨɨgi'ñdham na gu' tu' jix duñia' jix bhaan; na ba' cham bɨɨx gu ko'oi ko'oi na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim bhaan gu oidha'.
Na gu' na gu' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix tɨ'ɨ gu oidha' gu Ejipto na ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' boopoya' jɨɨgi'ñdham na gu' tu' jix duñia' jix bhaan.

Jano' ba' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu vaakax gu u'uvhig bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na jix do'ig oidha' bhaan jiim gu suudai' bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n ko'oi na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim bhaan gu oidha'.
Na ba' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ ñaanbi' na jix bhai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaakax jɨ'xdha' jugi gu vaakax cham jɨ'xdha' jugi.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; na pai' dhuuk gu u'vɨ na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a kɨɨv gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr jurtu'nka' gu tanoolh ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chuukug gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook vaik gu tanoolh gu ɨ'ɨr; gio ba' matgɨm jix bhaan abhaar gu ñi'ook tu' ɨlhdham xidhuu bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gook jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh gu ɨ'ɨr.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ua'tulhi'ñ gu mar mar u'vɨ mar kaneer oi'ñga' na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu ñi'ook na ba' ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook ka't na jix bhai' ɨ'ra'n gu ɨ'ɨr; gio ba' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu ñi'ook na ba' mar kaneer jix bhɨɨ jano' ba' gook gu ñi'ook gook maa'n na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan na ba' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook ka't.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon bham.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu chio'ñ palhɨɨp zel gu chuukug gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhɨɨya' zel gu chuukug na ja'p tu jiim dua'ñdha' ka't gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan maa'n jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu jiim zel gu chuukug; gio ba' tu' tu jiim tu' jix toja tu jiim gu chuukug tu jiim dua'ñdha'; mi' dhɨr jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan maa'n ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' tu' zel gu chuukug bhɨɨya' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu' cham tu' bhɨɨya' jix toja jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan kɨɨv gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' tu jiim bhɨɨya' dhi' cham zel jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan kɨɨv gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix vɨɨk; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jix bhai'x tu jiim cham tu' zel jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan maa'n; mi' dhɨr ka't; jano' ba' jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ ka't.
Gu' gu' tu' bhɨɨya' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam zel mi' dhɨr ka't jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan na ba' na jix bhai' ka't buupui jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tu' zel jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan maa'n ñaanbi'; gio ba' dua'ñdha'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk bhɨɨya' tu jiim dua'ñdha' gu chio'ñ ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix toja zel ka't jix uam gu chuukug gu tai.
Jano' ba' dua'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam zel gu chuukug; na gu' maa'n ñaanbi' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan cham na gu' ñaanbi'.
Gu' gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dua'ñdha' bɨx zel dɨr mo'o bɨɨx ka'm tɨɨt bɨx ñiata gu vupui jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' dua'ñdha' bhɨɨya' jix bhaan dhaas bɨx gu chuukug maa'n; mi' dhɨr bɨx; jano' ba'.
Gu' gu' gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chuukug gu tai ka't ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chuukug gu tai maa'n ñaanbi'; gio ba' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu chuukug gu tai; mi' dhɨr dua'ñdha'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug gu tai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' ba' ɨlhdham jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu jiim bhɨɨya' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan maa'n na jix bhai' ga'ra' tu jiim ka't.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug zel bhɨɨya' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' jix toja ka't jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' zel bhɨɨya' jix toja maa'n jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ñaanbi'; mi' dhɨr tu jiim dua'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' tu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jix toja tu' zel gu ñi'ook jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan kɨɨv gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' tu' ua'tulhi'ñ jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam zel jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan maa'n ñaanbi'; gio ba' tu jiim.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' cham ka't; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan maa'n.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug palhɨɨp zel gu tai bhɨɨya' gu tai.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' bhɨɨya' jix toja zel dua'ñdha' jix buus; mi' dhɨr jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ñaanbi' tu jiim dua'ñdha'.
Gu' gu' tu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jix toja tu' gu ñi'ook jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan kɨɨv gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' bhɨɨya' jix duñia' zel jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan maa'n ñaanbi'; mi' dhɨr tu jiim dua'ñdha'.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' cham bhɨɨya' zel gu ñi'ook; gio ba' maa'n jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; na nɨi'ñchudat.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu jiim mo'o.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu jiim; gio ba' tu' mai' jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan maa'n ñaanbi'; mi' dhɨr dua'ñdha' mo'o.
Na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bhɨɨya' tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu' ua'tulhi'ñ jix tuk jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook kɨɨv gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu jiim; gio ba' tu' cham jix duñia' tu' bhɨɨya' tu'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' bhaan gu' cham bhaan pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan juraa'n kɨɨv gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' tu' cham bhɨɨya' zel tu' kutun jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan maa'n; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ ka't.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhɨɨya' jix duñia' zel mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' bhɨɨya' zel cham jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ñaanbi'.
Gu' gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook jix tuk; gio ba' maa'n jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ na pai' dhuuk zel gu chuukug palhɨɨp chooto.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' zel gu chuukug chooto gu ñi'ook jix buusñi zel gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk gu chio'ñ na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mo'o jix bhai'x gu' na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' tu' baasɨ'n gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mo'o jix bhai'x vupui bhaan gu' na jix bhai'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhɨɨya' tu jiim dua'ñdha' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu jiim na ja'p dua'ñdha' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gakiidha' ñaanbi'; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñaanbi'; mi' dhɨr mo'o juraa'n tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gakiidha' bhɨɨya' tu jiim jajannulhi'ñ ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mo'o; gio ba' ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't ñaanbi'; gio ba' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr jix daa; jano' ba' mai' vaak ja'tkam ka't gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk tɨi'chu' bhɨɨya' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dua'ñdha' tɨi'chu'.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam zel no'x gu ñi'ook zel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu vaas tɨi'chu' zel dhi' gu ñi'ook no'x tu duukam zel; gio ba' dua'ñdha' tu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' bhɨɨya' tɨi'chu' dhi' gu ñi'ook zel no'x gu ñi'ook duñia' tɨɨt dua'ñdha' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a ka't.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨi'chu' dhi' gu ñi'ook no'x tu duukam tɨɨt bhɨɨya' jix duñia'; na gu' dua'ñdha' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu tai ka't vaak na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' tu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham ka't tɨi'chu' dhi' gu ñi'ook no'x tu duukam tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' kɨɨv gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mi' dhɨr ua'tulhi'ñ; gio ba' tu' cham tu' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam cham ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; na gu ñi'ook gu tai; jano' ba' gu vupui mii' dhɨr.
Gu' gu' tu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix bhai'x mi' dhɨr ka't tɨi'chu' zel dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨi'chu' dhi' gu ñi'ook no'x tɨɨt gu ñi'ook gu tai mii' dhɨr pai'.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tɨi'chu' dhi' gu ñi'ook no'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam zel jix duñia' tu' gookim jix duñia' jano' ba' ka't na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dua'ñdha' tɨi'chu' dhi' gu ñi'ook no'x zel na ba' ka't na jix bhai' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Na pai' dhuuk dhi' ka't ñi'ook na tu a'ga gakiidha' na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' ka't jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mai' vaak ja'tkam; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ñɨi'ñ jix duñia' dua'ñdha' gakiidha'.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu ñi'ook gɨ' u'u kavɨk tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan kooda' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a vaaso bhi'ñ bhaan gu suudai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu tai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bɨɨx gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu tai gu ɨ'ɨr gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a muukix bhaan gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv mui'kim bhaan dua'ñdha' maa'n na jix bhai'; gio ba' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu tai bhaan gu vupui yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ bɨx tu' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu suudai' ka't na jix bhai'; gio ba' mi' dhɨr vaak ja'tkam mai' vaak zel kɨɨv gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' ka't kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx mo'o gu vupui; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ jix duñia' gu chuukug gu suudai' ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh jix bhai'x jix bhɨɨ gook ali' karneer cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ali' karneer oi'ñga' cham; gio ba' vaik gu ñi'ook na ba' bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx mii' dhɨr tu'x tu' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan mar kaneer gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' na ja'p gu maa'nkar vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mar kaneer pai' uañi'ñ maa'nkar tai bhaan pai' xidhuu; na gu' na ja'p uañi'ñ gio gu ñi'ook jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ɨ'ɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bhaan naak tu jiim bhaan gu novɨ tu jiim bhaan tɨɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhɨɨ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bɨ'ñdhatu' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu novɨ o'nsop.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨ'ñdhatu' juraa'n gu novɨ o'nsop bɨ'ñdhatu' bɨɨx kɨɨv mui'kim vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨ'ñdhatu' juraa'n gu novɨ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bhaan naak tu jiim bhaan gu novɨ tu jiim bhaan tɨɨt gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ɨ'ɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨ'ñdhatu' juraa'n gu novɨ bhaan mo'o; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu maa'nkar uañi'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' mi' dhɨr maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix tɨ'ɨ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook ka't.

Gu' gu' tu' ua'tulhi'ñ gampai' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ mar kaneer na ba' na ja'p gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook na ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' na ba' bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' gook gu ñi'ook gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ; gio ba' maa'n ka't na ba' uañi'ñ na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Jano' ba' tu'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu tanoolh jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix bhɨɨ mar kaneer gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨ'ñdhatu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan na ja'p gu maa'nkar vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mar kaneer gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ɨ'ɨr gu ñi'ook bhaan naak tu jiim bhaan gu novɨ tu jiim bhaan tɨɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨ'ñdhatu' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu novɨ o'nsop.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bɨ'ñdhatu' juraa'n gu novɨ o'nsop kɨɨv mui'kim vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bɨ'ñdhatu' juraa'n gu novɨ bhaan naak tu jiim bhaan gu novɨ tu jiim bhaan tɨɨt gu ñi'ook pai' gu ɨ'ɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨ'ñdhatu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan juraa'n gu novɨ bhaan mo'o na ba' jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ maa'nkar tai bhaan; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook tu' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga bhɨɨya' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dua'ñdha' gu novɨ cham na ba' jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon bham.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kia'mi'ñ gu oidha' gu Kanaan tu' gu maa'nkar tu' dua'ñdha' gu vaak gu oidha' gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' ɨlhdham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ua'tulhi'ñ gu vaak maa'n aa'ñdham jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bham; gio ba' na ja'p tu' gu vaak.

Na gu' jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak va'k jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tɨjɨɨ'ñ na gu' cham ka't bɨx gu vaak; gio ba' mi' dhɨr jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' gu vaak gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak ki'ñgob gu ñi'ook gu vaak kɨɨv gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' bhɨɨya' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai jix duñia' mai' kiicham pai' ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu ñi'ook xikoolh gu ñi'ook oo' mai' kiicham pai' ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu jodai jix duñia' pai' gu jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ bhi'ñ gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix duu tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu vaak mi' dhɨr gu jodai gu vaak mi' dhɨr ka't.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu vaak dua'ñdha' jix duñia' gu vaak; mi' dhɨr gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu vaak gu jodai jix duu bɨx gu vaak; gio ba' mai' kiicham pai' ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' no'x ba'k mii' dhɨr gu vaak bɨx gu tanoolh jix aa'ñdhix jix duu ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu vaak jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ; gio ba' gio gu vaak jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ.
Na gu' gu' tu' ba'k jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' cham tu' gu vaak mi' dhɨr ka't jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan maa'n gu vaak na jix bhai' na gu' tu'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gɨ' u'u kavɨk tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu ñi'ook bhi'ñ bhaan gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu tai gu ɨ'ɨr gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a muukix gu suudai' gu vaak kɨɨv mui'kim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak bɨɨx gu ɨ'ɨr gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a bɨɨx gu suudai' bɨɨx gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu tai gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu tai mai' kiicham bhaan gu vupui yooxi'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak ka't.
Jano' ba' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ñi'ook bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dua'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' dua'ñdha' tɨi'chu' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Na ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook duuk ñaanbi' duuk na jix bhai'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na tu a'ga dua'ñdha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel ja'xñi; na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ na pai' dhuuk gu kai' gu chuukug ka't ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' dhi' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨ'ra'n; gio ba' ka't gu chuukug kuiñcha ɨ'ra'n gu chuukug kuiñcha ɨ'ra'n ka't ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam palhɨɨp ɨ'ra'n ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; gio ba' bɨx bhaan gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a ka't.
Jano' ba' no'x kuichdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ; gio ba' gio bɨɨx gu suudai' ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan mii' dhɨr bhɨɨya' daakat juraa'n ɨ'ra'n jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ jix duñia' gio bɨɨx gu suudai' ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuichdha' gu chuukug juraa'n ɨ'ra'n jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ jix duñia' bɨɨx gu suudai' ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' tu' juraa'n ɨ'ra'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan na jix bhai' jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ mi' dhɨr jix duñia' tooton bɨɨx gu suudai' ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan palhɨɨp ɨ'ra'n ka't ñaanbi'.

Jano' ba' no'x kuichdha' no'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't dhi' bɨtaa'n ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai; gio ba' jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ mi' dhɨr jix duñia' bɨɨx gu suudai' ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' bɨx mii' dhɨr kuichdha' juraa'n ɨ'ra'n cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu suudai' gu noobh jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ jix duñia' bɨɨx gu suudai' ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bhi'ñ kuichdha' juraa'n ɨ'ra'n ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu u'u ka't bɨɨx gu suudai'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk bhɨɨya' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨ'ra'n juraa'n ɨ'ra'n tu' gu ñi'ook kɨɨv gu tanoolh dɨr jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ jix duñia' gu chuukug gu suudai' ka't na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x gu tanoolh jix bhɨɨ gook gu ñi'ook gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨlhdham vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut maa'n jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix maat jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan maa'n gu maa'nkar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ maa'nkar tai bhaan; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ɨ'ra'n vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk gu chio'ñ na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kai' jix duñia' gu suudai' bɨx gu chuukug ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx zel bhaan bhɨɨya' gu kai' bɨɨx gu suudai' ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ bɨɨx gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kai' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu suudai' ka't jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu u'vɨ palhɨɨp ɨ'ra'n gu ɨ'ɨr ɨ'ra'n ua'tulhi'ñ gu chuukug kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' no'x kuichdha' ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' bɨx mii' dhɨr bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't ñaanbi'; gio ba' gio bɨx mii' dhɨr bhaan ka't ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' no'x kuichdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ mi' dhɨr jix duñia' bɨɨx gu suudai' ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' gio no'x kuichdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan bhɨɨya' daakat jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ; gio ba' bɨɨx gu suudai' ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan bhɨɨya' daakat kuichdha' ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' tu' oi'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ua'tulhi'ñ bhaan ka't ñaanbi' kɨɨv gu tanoolh; gio ba' bɨx bhaan ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.

Na pai' dhuuk gu u'vɨ na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨ'ra'n gu ɨ'ɨr mui'x gu tanoolh mai' gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk palhɨɨp ɨ'ra'n gu ɨ'ɨr; gio ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook ɨ'ra'n ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a na ja'p gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook ɨ'ra'n ka't na ja'p; gio ba' bɨx bhaan ka't ñaanbi' na ja'p.
Jano' ba' no'x kuichdha' jix duñia' tu'x ka't ñaanbi'; gio ba' jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ jix duñia' bɨɨx gu suudai' ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk ua'tulhi'ñ namkidhat ɨ'ra'n tu' gu ñi'ook kɨɨv gu tanoolh mi' dhɨr ka't na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x gu tanoolh jix bhɨɨ baidhak gook gu ñi'ook gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n gu maa'nkar uañi'ñ maa'nkar tai bhaan; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios ɨ'ra'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook cham vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga juraa'n ɨ'ra'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kai' bai'ñpu' ñaanbi' kuiñcha.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook palhɨɨp ɨ'ra'n ka't gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ gu chio'ñ bɨɨx gu u'vɨ gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees mi' dhɨr jix koko' gook gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix koko'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' tu' gu Aaroon xibhɨk cham bɨx gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ xidhuu jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan iiñat bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' na ba' cham; na gu' tu' toov bhaan iiñat.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aaroon xidhuu; gio ba' bɨɨx tuur gu ñi'ook maa'nkar tai bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook abhaar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhaan gu chuukug jix duu gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨɨx; mi' dhɨr jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' kutun; jano' ba' bɨɨx mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu chuukug bɨɨx gu suudai' tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bhɨɨ gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chiiw na ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aaroon tuur gu ñi'ook gu vaak.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ gook gu vupui chiiw gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mamai'chɨk gu Aaroon bhaan gook chiiw; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Asasel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aaroon gu chio'ñ chiiw bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' gu chio'ñ chiiw bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Asasel gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu vupui bhaan na ba' tɨip gu Asasel oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aaroon tuur ka't na ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu ñi'ook tuur.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ vaak na jix bhaan jix bhuup gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai jodai maa'nkar Jawatan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu tai vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios toov gu ñi'ook iiñat bhaan chuut cham koi.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ɨ'ɨr tuur gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx bhaan iiñat gu ñi'ook gu ux na tu ibai'; gio ba' bhaan iiñat kɨɨv mui'kim mii' dhɨr gu ɨ'ɨr bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ chiiw ka't gu ja'tkam gu ɨ'ɨr jix duñia'; gio ba' gu ɨ'ɨr na ja'p jix duu gu ɨ'ɨr tuur bhaan iiñat vupui bhaan iiñat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xidhuu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨx uañi'ñ; gio ba' gio vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut na pai' dhuuk ba'k xidhuu bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu ñi'ook gu vaak bɨx gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ɨ'ɨr tuur gu ɨ'ɨr gu chio'ñ chiiw bhaan a'aa' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan xikoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ɨ'ɨr bɨɨx kɨɨv mui'kim jix bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk bhɨɨya' gu ñi'ook xidhuu vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ chiiw gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aaroon gu noobh bhaan mo'o gu chio'ñ chiiw gu ñi'ook bhaan bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨx uañi'ñ bhaan mo'o gu chio'ñ chiiw gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki jix bhai'x gu novɨ gu chio'ñ na ba' dhi'.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ chiiw gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan bɨx gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; gio ba' kiicha' tu' gu chio'ñ chiiw oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr ɨlhdham gu Aaroon vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't tɨi'chu' na ba' baakɨi xidhuu.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug bɨɨx gu suudai' pai' xidhuu mi' dhɨr jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' bhɨɨya' baabuk gu chio'ñ chiiw gu Asasel jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ jix duñia' gio bɨɨx gu suudai' gu chuukug mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mai' vaak ja'tkam tuur uañi'ñ gu chio'ñ chiiw gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr ka't na ba' bhaan gu ñi'ook xidhuu; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tai gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ jix duñia' gio gu chuukug bɨɨx gu suudai' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' dhi' gui'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook kavɨk; gio ba' kɨɨv mambhɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ matgɨm gu ñi'ook tu' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' dhi' gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' boopoya' bɨx uañi'ñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Saabado jɨɨpi'ñka' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ ñi'ook kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ua'tulhi'ñ Xoi'kam gu novɨ bhɨɨya' jix duñia' jix bhuup na ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan pai' gu taat; gio ba' gu ñi'ook kutun.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook xidhuu jix bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gio jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bɨx gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' dhi' gui'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook kavɨk na ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨx uañi'ñ jix duñia' oi'ñga'; gio ba' gu Moisees jix duu na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' dhi' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu vaak gu Israeel gu vaakax mar kaneer gu ñi'ook vaak ja'tkam mai' vaak ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu ɨ'ɨr ka't jix duñia' gu chio'ñ; gio ba' gu ɨ'ɨr ja'aa; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't jix duñia' gu chio'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.

Na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel makgɨrxi'ñdha' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan bhaan gu vupui yooxi' na ba' gu Jawatan Dios ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tu jiim gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak na jix bhai' makgɨrxi'ñdha' i'ii'mda' bhaan jix duñia'; gio ba' jix duñia' dhi' ñi'ook kavɨk.
Jano' ba' daipu' gio; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu vaak gu Israeel gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ maa'nkar tai bhaan gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut na ba' duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu chio'ñ ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu vaak gu Israeel gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ɨ'ɨr tu' gu vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Na gu' na gu' gu oidha' gu chuukug gu ɨ'ɨr; gio ba' tu' jix maa na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu ɨ'ɨr gu ñi'ook.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' matgɨm gu ñi'ook jugi gu ɨ'ɨr tu' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jugi gu ɨ'ɨr.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu u'uvhig ka't jugi gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr bɨɨx gu oidha'.

Na gu' na gu' gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu chuukug gu oidha' gu ɨ'ɨr; na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; na gu' cham jugi gu ɨ'ɨr matgɨm gu chuukug na gu' gu oidha' bɨx gu chuukug gu ɨ'ɨr; jano' ba' no'x ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' no'x gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ jix duñia' bɨɨx gu suudai' ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p xoi'kam gu oidha' gu Ejipto; gio ba' tu' na ja'p xoi'kam gu oidha' gu Kanaan tu'; mi' dhɨr tu' ñi'ook kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam ñi'ook kavɨk jiim; gio ba' gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook kavɨk duñia' gu chio'ñ ii'mdagaram; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ matgɨm mia'n gu chuukug na ba' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu taat gu ñi'ook gu naan cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu naan cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ gu taat cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam mar u'vɨ gu taat mar u'vɨ gu naan jix duñia' gu vaak jix duñia' mai' gu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu mar mar u'vɨ gu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu u'vɨ gu taat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu taat gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook cham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu taat cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu naan cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu naan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook xibhɨk gu taat cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham jix duñia' gu u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr gu u'vɨ xibhɨk gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham; gio ba' gu u'vɨ gu mar; mi' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ xibhɨk cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ mar u'vɨ cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim mar u'vɨ gu mar tu' mar u'vɨ na ba' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' cham gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu u'vɨ bɨɨma'n bɨɨx gu ja'tkam na ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' gu u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jix duñia' bɨɨx gu u'vɨ tɨtmo.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kai' na ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tai gu Molok; gio ba' cham gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu chio'ñ na ja'p bɨɨx gu u'vɨ; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' tu' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax bɨɨx; gio ba' tu' gu u'vɨ vupui bhaan gu vaakax na ba' bɨɨx; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' matgɨm dhi' tu'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' bɨx dhi' tu'x jix duñia' chɨbɨɨp tu' vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' ka't jix duñia'; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na cham jir bhai' bhaan gu oidha' jix duñia' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook kavɨk cham matgɨm bɨx dhi'; gio ba' tu' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' bɨx dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duu gu chichio'ñ gu oidha' jix bɨɨx duu va'k gu oidha' ka't jix duñia'; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' cham jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' na ja'p jix duñia' gu ja'tkam ka't va'k.
Na gu' na gu' no'x jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx dhi' ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jir bɨx bhai' cham gu ñi'ook chooto'n pai' va'k cham; gio ba' gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' jɨɨgi'ñdham boopoya' na gu' jix bhaan jix duñia' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu ñi'ook gu naan gu taat tas na jix bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duiñxim tu' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu maa'nkar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios aagak maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan buimgidhak gu tanoolh; gio ba' na ba' vaik gu tanoolh ka't gu tai.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh vaik ka't; gio ba' cham ka't.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ja'tkam.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' u'va tu' vaak na jix bhaan oidha' u'va; na ba' gampai' na ba' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr kiicha'; mi' dhɨr gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu' tɨtmo.
Jano' ba' cham ñi'ook kavɨk aa' gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨtmo tu'; gio ba' cham tu jiim gu vaak bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x vupui bhaan bai'ñchu' cham gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu' choo'n gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jir bhai'; gio ba' cham gampai' tu' nɨidhat jix gɨ'; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx bɨx bhai' tɨtmo.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' cham tu' bhaan gu ɨ'ɨr tɨtmo; mi' dhɨr gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xibhɨk gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' tɨtmo cham bhaan uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam; gu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tɨtmo na ja'p tu'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ñi'ook kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n cham jix duu na ba' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu kai' cham tu' jajannulhi'ñ bɨɨx ɇɇka' tu'x.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu chio'ñ palhɨɨp gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu u'vɨ ua'tulhi'ñ ja'tkam na tu juan gu ñi'ook bɨɨx oi'ñdha' cham tu' bhɨɨya' jix duñia' ka't gɨɨ'bia'; na gu' cham koi na gu' cham namkidhat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios uañi'ñ; gio ba' uañi'ñka' uañi'ñ tu'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kia'mi'ñ gu oidha' gu ux na tu ibai' bɨx gu u'u jugi jix duñia' maa'n gu i'bhɨ; gio ba' vaik ka't gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu i'bhɨ cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' maakobh oi'ñga' bɨx gu i'bhɨ ka't jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' jixchamaam oi'ñga' jugi gu i'bhɨ na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'bhɨ; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham jugi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ɨ'ɨr; gio ba' cham boopoya' tu'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ɨɨbhidham tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chuukug jix koi tu' gu ñi'ook nɨi'ñchudat; gio ba' gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mar u'vɨ; na gu' cham gu oidha' tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' tas na jix bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xidhuu gui'x tu jiim; gio ba' gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham bɨɨx; mi' dhɨr gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' vupui bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' nɨidhat gu vupui jix bhai'x gu Jawatan Dios choo'n; gio ba' gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios.
