Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨndak gu oidha' cham.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gui'x ja'tkam mii' dhɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' na ja'p tu'; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Ejipto; jano' ba' gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu oidha' tu' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bhai' gu Epa jir bhai' tu' jir bhai' gui'x; gio ba' gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx ñi'ook kavɨk bɨx tu duukam; gio ba' gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' daipu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu kai' gu Molok gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam gu oidha' bɨɨx gu jodai.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui bhaan jix duñia' gu chio'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam; na gu' jix maa gu kai' gu Molok xidhuu jix bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Na tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu vupui mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ bhɨɨya' jix maa gu kai' gu Molok na ba' cham mu'aa'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui bhaan mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ bhaan ja'tkam vaak tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam bɨɨx bɨx bɨɨx gu Molok.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ba' bhaan tu' gu vupui bhaan jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Na gu' jix bhaan gu ñi'ook jɨɨgi'ñdham na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook kavɨk tu duukam; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' gu chio'ñ jix duñia' gu taat gu naan tɨɨda' koi; gio ba' gu taat gu naan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr gu ɨ'ɨr ka't bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu u'vɨ jix duñia' bɨɨx gu u'vɨ tɨtmo koi.
Jano' ba' no'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu u'vɨ gu taat gu ñi'ook gu taat jix ñi'ñ; gio ba' jix duñia' koko'kam; mi' dhɨr gu ɨ'ɨr ka't bhaan.
Jano' ba' no'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx jix duñia' koi; gio ba' jix duu gu jodai' na jix uam; mi' dhɨr gu ɨ'ɨr ka't bhaan.
Jano' ba' no'x palhɨɨp gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu chio'ñ na ja'p bɨɨx gu u'vɨ jix duu; gio ba' ba'k jix duñia' koko'kam; mi' dhɨr bhaan ka't gu ɨ'ɨr.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu u'vɨ gu naan gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu tai na gu' cham ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' no'x palhɨɨp gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu vaakax tu' jix koi; gio ba' kooda' gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax na ba' mambhɨɨx bɨɨx gu u'vɨ gu vaakax koo'nda'; gio ba' koi; mi' dhɨr ka't gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan.

Jano' ba' no'x gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ja'tkam mar u'vɨ gu taat mar u'vɨ gu naan jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na ba' ka't koko'kam gu vupui gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr jix ñi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam; jano' ba' uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' no'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook suudai' buusñi jix ñi'ñ suudai' buusñi gu ɨ'ɨr; gio ba' ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu naan gu ja'tkam gu taat cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' jix ñi'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' no'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu u'vɨ xibhɨk gu taat gu ñi'ook xibhɨk gu taat jix ñi'ñ; gio ba' uañi'ñ; mi' dhɨr koi cham gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu u'vɨ xibhɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook xibhɨk jix ñi'ñ; mi' dhɨr cham gu ma'nkam ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx ñi'ook kavɨk bɨx tu duukam; gio ba' cham jix duñia' gu oidha' tu' na ba'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam tu' vupui bhaan; na gu' jix duu bɨx dhi' tu'x jix duñia'.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bia'ka' gu oidha' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu maa'nkar gu oidha' bii'm gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam.

Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n na jix bhai' tu' ñaanbi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu u'uvhig gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; gio ba' cham gu vaakax tu' gu u'uvhig tu' matgɨm tu' ko'oi na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim gu oidha' jix bhai'x.
Na gu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨɨgi'ñdham na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' jix bhaan gu ja'tkam na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ bhɨɨya' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' koko'kam; gio ba' bɨɨx gu jodai; mi' dhɨr gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' tu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jix koi gu ja'tkam.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jir bɨx bhai' mia'n gu naan gu taat gu mar xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook mia'n cham ka't jix duñia' gu chio'ñ.
Na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' cham jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mo'o tu' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jɨɨgi'ñdham ka't gu Jawatan Dios cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios; na ba' ka't jɨɨgi'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ ganai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jix bhɨɨ; gio ba' tu' jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ gu chio'ñ; na gu' jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' jix bhaan ka't na ba' tu' na gu' jix bhaan jix duñia' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' mar u'vɨ gu chio'ñ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tu' kua'da' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu taat; gio ba' vaak na jix bhaan ka't gu tai.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam bhaan mo'o ka't vaak na jix bhaan bɨ'ñdhatu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ na ba' gu ñi'ook cham mo'o tu' jajannulhi'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' ka't gu ñi'ook muukix tu' gu taat gu naan.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xidhuu tu' xidhuu gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' kuruun bɨ'ñdhatu' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ganai' cham jix bhɨɨ; gu' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kai' gu ja'tkam; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Aaroon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu kai' gu ma'nkam bhɨɨya' uañi'ñ cham na ba' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ bhɨɨya' uañi'ñ; gio ba' gu chio'ñ bai'ñchu' jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ bhɨɨya' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨt gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh na jix bhai' palhɨɨp toov gu vupui jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu kai' gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bhɨɨya' uañi'ñ na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham tu'x jai'ch uañi'ñ; mi' dhɨr cham gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt jix bhaan tu'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi.
Na gu' cham gu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tu' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na gu' cham tu'x jai'ch uañi'ñ; na gu' cham xidhuu na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees dhi' gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham jix bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨx gu chio'ñ bɨx gu kai' gu ma'nkam tu'x gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios ua'tulhdhidha' bhaan vupui bhaan tu' ka't gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu kai' gu Aaroon ua'tulhi'ñ gakiidha' ɨ'ra'n cham jugi tu'x bɨɨx ka'm na jix bhai'; gio ba' kuichdha' no'x gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu chio'ñ bhɨɨya' gu ñi'ook gu kai'.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ bhɨɨya' dhaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ko'oi ka't ñaanbi' tu' gu chio'ñ ñaanbi' jurtu'nka' no'x.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook kuichdha' ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai cham jugi tu'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam va'k ka't tooton gu chuukug bɨɨx gu suudai'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't na jix bhai'; na gu' mi' dhɨr jugi tu'x na gu' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' cham jugi na ba'; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' jir bɨx bhai' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ cham ka't na pai' dhuuk; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh na jix bhai' jugi; gio ba' onbai' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tu' cham jugi.
Na pai' dhuuk gu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tuumiñ jugi maaxir gu vaak; gio ba' suulhgia' jugi gu takarui'.
Na pai' dhuuk cham gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu chio'ñ gu tanoolh na jix bhai' cham jugi gu maa'nkar tu'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.

Gu' gu' tu' mar u'vɨ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ua'tulhi'ñ ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham palhɨɨp bhɨɨya' gu vaak gu taat na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu taat; gu' gu tanoolh na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jixchamaam maa'n jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'x jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bhai'x na ba' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ jugi tu'x jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu vaak gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu maa'nkar bɨx gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Jano' ba' aagak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ cham tɨjɨɨ'ñ kaneer tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' matgɨm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't uañi'ñ na gu' cham ka't gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu' ka't kakneer cham ka't; gio ba' cham tu' uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' bai'ñchu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham suulhgia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu vaakax gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar; gu' cham ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cham gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu novɨ gu mar ja'tkam mii' dhɨr cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx dhi' tu'x; na gu' ja'bsuna'; mi' dhɨr cham tu'x jai'ch uañi'ñ cham.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Na pai' dhuuk gu vaakax mar kaneer gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu naan; gu' dɨr jix bhai'x gu tanoolh jix duñia' ka't na ba' gu maa'nkar jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't gu vaakax gu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh gu mar.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu maa'nkar taxchaabgidhat taxchaabgi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios aagak maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh jugi; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Ejipto na ba' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh kɨɨv gu tanoolh juanda' jɨɨpi'ñka' ka't abhaar; gio ba' matgɨm gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr juanda' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook xib ja'k tɨkɨr gakdhi'ñchix gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh dhi' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jugi.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu tanoolh gui'x abhaar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' matgɨm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai'; gio ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh ka't abhaar; mi' dhɨr matgɨm gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na pai' dhuuk kia'mi'ñ gu oidha' tu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan dharka' gu i'bhɨ oraa'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba'; gio ba' buimgidhak gu tanoolh juanda' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mar kaneer oi'ñga' cham maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gook gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' suudai' u'va gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n.
Jano' ba' cham jugi gu takarui' tu' kai'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨɨx ka'm dhi' gu tanoolh bɨɨx ka'm gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ñi'ook kavɨk bɨx.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook dɨr buimgidhak gu tanoolh juanda' dɨr gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar; gio ba' kɨɨv ka't.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm buimgidhak gu tanoolh juanda' kɨɨv gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx gu tanoolh; gio ba' jano' ba' jix vɨɨk gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook gu takarui' na ba' gu maa'nkar ka't gook gu ñi'ook bɨɨx jabka' gu ux na tu ibai' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu takarui' kɨɨv ali' karneer oi'ñga' cham tuur gook gu chuukug; gio ba' ka't maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu vaak na jix bhai'; mi' dhɨr gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ chiiw; gio ba' gook ali' karneer oi'ñga' gu maa'nkar.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu takarui' gu ux na tu ibai' gook ali' karneer; gio ba' ka't gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu tanoolh; gio ba' ka't abhaar; mi' dhɨr matgɨm gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' ñi'ook kavɨk bɨx.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' cham gu ñi'ook tu' oraa'; na ba' gampai' na ba' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr kiicha'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' kɨɨv maa'n gui'x juanda' kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk abhaar.
Jano' ba' matgɨm gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv ka't gu tanoolh; gio ba' gui'x abhaar gu i'ii'ñ gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' matgɨm gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu tanoolh; na gu' gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook na ba' jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' bɨx gu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu tanoolh ka't gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' no'x gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu tanoolh tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' matgɨm gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' ñi'ook kavɨk bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Saabado jɨɨpi'ñka' ka't gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ kua'da' gu ñi'ook gu xumai; gio ba' gu xumai juanda'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu tanoolh dhi' kɨɨv ka't gu Jawatan Dios kɨɨv gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam abhaar; gio ba' matgɨm gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix bhai'x gu tanoolh gui'x abhaar gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr; jano' ba' matgɨm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' na ba' gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar tai bhaan gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tas na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios juana' bɨx maa'nkar na jix maa gu Jawatan Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv na pai' dhuuk gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios kɨɨv gu tanoolh; gio ba' maa'n gu tanoolh ka't juanda'; mi' dhɨr juanda' ka't gio jix bhai'x gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim maa'n gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu i'bhɨ gu u'u jix duñia' gu ñi'ook mamraga'n gu u'u; gio ba' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios kɨɨv gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios kɨɨv gu tanoolh oi'ñga'; gio ba' ka't ñi'ook kavɨk; mi' dhɨr kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv gu tanoolh; gio ba' bɨx gu Israeel jix daa.
Na pai' dhuuk na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix daa gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na pai' dhuuk gu oidha' gu Ejipto; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨ'ñdhatu' gu ñi'ook na ba' bhaan tɨtɨɨya gu vaak na jix bhai'.

Jano' ba' mai' jix duñia' chuut vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aaroon dɨr gu xumai bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak na jix bhai'; gio ba' ñi'ook kavɨk.
Jano' ba' bhaan mɨichdhai na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx tas tɨtɨɨya vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu takarui'; gio ba' gu takarui' ka't gook gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' na jix bhai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio bhaan kubhion na jix bhai' ka't na ba' gu takarui' gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh juanda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak na jix bhai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu Israeel ñi'ook na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jugi pai' jix bhaan; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt abhaar na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar gu u'vɨ gu Israelita ka't gu mar gu Egipkio jix buus tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu mar gu Israelita gu chio'ñ gu Israeel vaak ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu mar gu u'vɨ gu Israelita gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' jano' ba' bhɨɨk gu Moisees; mi' dhɨr gu naan gu Selomit mar u'vɨ gu Dribi bopxi'ñ gu Dan.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas kuupa' bɨɨx ka'm jum duu jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' jix buusñi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mai' vaak ja'tkam bɨx gu noobh bhaan mo'o bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' no'x jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na cham jir bhai'.

Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix koi; gio ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr ja'tkam mii' dhɨr na ja'p tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ koi'm no'x gu ñi'ook koi'm.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax tu'; gio ba' gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' jix duu kuiñcha gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨtmo bhaan ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui taatam; gio ba' bhaan gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax tu'; gu' koi'm gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gui'x; gio ba' na ja'p ja'tkam mii' dhɨr ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mai' vaak ja'tkam bɨɨx gu jodai; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duu bhaan gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Moisees.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu kavɨk gu Sinaii bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na pai' dhuuk kia'mi'ñ gu oidha' tu' gu oidha' juanda' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' oidha' u'va gu i'bhɨ.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv oi'ñga' gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam juanda' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu oidha' tu' pai' u'va.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' cham jix duñia'; gio ba' cham; mi' dhɨr oi'ñga' ka't gu oidha'.
Gu' gu' juanda' gu oidha' ka't na ba' jugi tu' tu duukam gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios jix duñia' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨndak.
Jano' ba' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu vaakax bhɨɨya' gu oidha' ka't bɨx gu i'bhɨ na ba' jugi.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook kɨɨv gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv mui'kim kɨɨv; gio ba' gu tanoolh kɨɨv aajim oo'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv mambhɨɨx; gio ba' gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñga' mambhɨɨx gu oidha' bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n; gio ba' ka't; mi' dhɨr maa'n gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' oi'ñga' mambhɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't; gio ba' cham tu' gu oidha' tu'.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix bhaan ka't gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu oidha' jugi.
Jano' ba' dhi' oi'ñga' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n gu maa'nkar.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tɨtmo gu novɨ tɨtmo cham iatgi'ñdha' xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' jurtu'nka' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mi' dhɨr tɨtmo; gio ba' jurtu'nka' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu i'bhɨ tu' gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' jurtu'nka' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam u'uuk jurtu'nka' u'uuk; na gu' bhaan jɨɨ'ñdhidha' tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham iatgi'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨtmo; gu' choo'n gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook kavɨk tu duukam gu oidha' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' maa'n gu i'bhɨ jugi bɨɨx ka'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jugi kɨɨv oi'ñga' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu i'bhɨ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook xijumai oi'ñga' gu i'bhɨ vaik.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñga' jix bhai'x jugi gu i'bhɨ; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm oi'ñga' jix bhai'x bɨɨx ka'm gu i'bhɨ jugi.
Na gu' gu oidha' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' gu oidha'; na gu ñi'ook na ba'.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu oidha' gu maa'nkar gu oidha'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk xibhɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar ɨlhdham mia'n xibhɨk bhɨɨya' jix duñia'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu chio'ñ cham palhɨɨp gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu novɨ bakia' jix duñia' na ba'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar.
Gu' gu' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ jix duñia' na ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm oi'ñga'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu vaak na jix bhai' kiicham mia'n u'ua'tɨda' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook oi'ñga'; gio ba' oi'ñga' ka't gu oidha' jix bhaai'.
Jano' ba' tu' cham ua'tulhi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook oi'ñga' gu vaak kiicham vaak jodai na ba' bɨɨx tas mii' dhɨr na ba'; gio ba' cham.
Gu' gu' gu vaak taañpu' cham namki' vaak jodai xikoolh ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu oidha'; gio ba' jix duñia'.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨ'dɨlh gu Lebitas bɨɨx tas gu Lebitas gu vaak jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Lebitas gu vaak kiicham gu maa'nkar; na gu' gu vaak jɨ'dɨlh gu Lebitas gu maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Na gu' gu' gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨ'dɨlh cham gu ñi'ook na gu' gu maa'nkar.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk xibhɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' na ja'p jix duñia' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr ii'mdagaram bɨndak.
Jano' ba' cham gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gu' choo'n gu Jawatan Dios xibhɨk ii'mdagaram bɨndak.
Jano' ba' cham maa'n tuumiñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Ejipto na ba' jix maa gu oidha' gu Kanaan na ba' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk xibhɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kua' bɨndak tu' cham jix duu tu juan na ja'p tu duukam.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix duñia' na ja'p ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨndak; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm oi'ñga' tu' tu juan.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨndak gu ma'nkam baidhak gu ñi'ook ja'tkam vaak gu maa'nkar tattat.
Na gu' na gu' tu duukam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu oidha' gu Ejipto; gio ba' cham ka't tu duukam.
Jano' ba' cham tu' gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu' choo'n gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu duukam na ja'p gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't chɨbɨɨp xikoolh; gio ba' tu duukam.
Jano' ba' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu oidha' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gui'x gu maa'nkar.

Jano' ba' tu' ua'tulhi'ñ jixchamaam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook ka't gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ mambhɨɨx.
Jano' ba' tu' ua'tulhi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm jixchamaam ka't gu chio'ñ jixchamaam jix toja jodai; gio ba' gu u'vɨ ka't vaik jix toja jodai.

Jano' ba' tu' jix bhaan duu gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu jiim gu ñi'ook jixchamaam tuumiñ na ba'.
